reasons.text: About 56% of this county's corn follows corn. Here corn and soybean are a small share of the cropland, so rotations aren't compared.
In years with excess rain from April to September, corn yields here tend to be about 9 bu/ac lower.
In years with a wet spring (planting delays), corn yields here tend to be about 5 bu/ac lower.

range_driver.text: What moves this county's corn range the most is season rain and water balance (Apr–Sep): from about -12 bu/ac in 2014 to almost no change in 2018.

twins_note.text: Counties like yours: 5. Their corn yield: 141–194 bu/ac (typical 173). Similar soil and weather doesn't guarantee the same result.
